output.explanation: Expanded core by pulling its held Agent and CacheWarmer into two deeper peripheral diagrams. The central diagram retains Runtime -> services/current session containment and session-owned coordination. The new diagrams expose engine state, queues, active-run state, callbacks, and cache-request/timer state without treating called loop functions or shared services as owned components. Left services, extensions-tools, and history-recovery unchanged because they already provide focused elaborations; shifted the first two only to make room. Checked the pinned checkout's runtime, SDK, session, agent-loop, cache-warmer, services, history, and extension/tool implementations. Corrected cache settlement: streaming-only warming stops rather than entering idle mode. Also made tool-call rejection precise: a length-stopped response rejects every tool call. Preserved all existing edges, relocating endpoints where concepts moved, and added containment and cross-peripheral connections.

diagrams.ascii:
Pi coding-agent session core
|  Nesting = held parts; "->" = calls/data, not containment
|
|-- Mode host: InteractiveMode / print / RPC
|   |-- -> session commands and subscriptions
|   `-- -> runtime replacement and host rebinding
|
|-- Assembly: createAgentSession() [sdk.ts]
|   |-- -> projection + model/settings/resources restore initial state
|   `-- constructs Agent + CacheWarmer + AgentSession
|
`-- AgentSessionRuntime [agent-session-runtime.ts]
    |-- Replacement: switch / new / fork / import
    |   `-- abort -> shutdown -> dispose -> factory -> rebind host
    |-- AgentSessionServices: cwd-bound held service references
    |   `-- -> shared policy, resources and model access
    `-- Current AgentSession [agent-session.ts]
        |-- Run coordination (session fields and methods)
        |   |-- Preflight/run flags; displayed queues; pending messages
        |   |-- prompt / steer / followUp / abort / waitForIdle
        |   |   `-- -> ExtensionRunner input hooks + resource expansion
        |   `-- _startRun(): -> Agent.prompt(); recovery/boundaries -> continue()
        |-- Agent: held turn engine [agent.ts]
        |   `-- State + queues + ActiveRun; -> agent-loop functions
        |-- SessionManager: held canonical history
        |   `-- projection -> Agent context (not the raw entry list)
        |-- Context maintenance (session methods, not manager methods)
        |   `-- compaction / navigation / retry -> history + Agent
        |-- ExtensionRunner: session-owned hook and API bindings
        |-- Tool environment: definitions, registry, loadout, nested calls
        |-- Shell state: cancellation + pending BashExecutionMessage
        |   `-- executeBash -> bash executor; ordered result -> history
        |-- CacheWarmer: optional held SDK collaborator
        |   `-- Request/prefix + timer + phase; -> model stream and usage history
        |-- Event bridge and public subscribers
        |   |-- Agent event -> extensions first -> public listeners
        |   |-- message_end -> SessionManager append
        |   `-- agent_settled after recovery/boundaries -> CacheWarmer.onAgentSettled()
        |-- Model selection: setModel / cycleModel / thinking
        |   `-- -> Agent + history; optional SettingsManager persistence
        |-- reload(): invalidate runner; reload settings/resources
        |   `-- rebuild bindings/registry; session_start when bound
        `-- dispose(): abort work; invalidate runner; detach listeners
            `-- cancel CacheWarmer; clean session resources

AgentSessionServices: cwd-bound references
|  [agent-session-services.ts; injected objects may be shared]
|
|-- SettingsManager [settings-manager.ts]
|   |-- Global/project/effective settings; project trust
|   |-- Storage, dirty fields, serialized writes, diagnostics
|   `-- -> run/queue/tool/retry/compaction/request policy
|-- ResourceLoader (default: DefaultResourceLoader)
|   |-- Package manager + resource metadata/diagnostics
|   |-- Loaded extensions/runtime registrations
|   |   `-- -> session's ExtensionRunner (not owned by loader)
|   |-- Skills/templates/themes/context/system prompt text
|   `-- reload/discovery -> prompt preparation + runtime rebuild
`-- ModelRuntime [model-runtime.ts]
    |-- MutableModels + RuntimeCredentials + ModelConfig
    |-- Provider composition, virtual models, availability snapshot
    |-- resolveModel / getAuth / login / logout / streamSimple
    |   `-- -> pi-ai provider catalog, auth and streaming
    `-- Called by (relationships, not owned children)
        |-- SDK stream wrapper -> streamSimple
        |   `-- Applies settings timeouts/retries + extension provider hooks
        |-- Summary requests and CacheWarmer -> model streaming
        `-- ExtensionRunner's ModelRegistry facade -> model/auth operations

AgentSession: extension and tool environment
|
|-- ExtensionRunner [extensions/runner.ts]
|   |-- Loaded extension/runtime references + flags/registrations
|   |-- Mode/UI bindings, command actions, error listeners
|   |-- ModelRegistry facade -> shared ModelRuntime
|   |-- Context reads -> SessionManager; actions -> AgentSession/host
|   `-- Input/context/tool/provider/boundary hooks affect execution
|-- Definition-first tool environment [agent-session.ts]
|   |-- Built-in/custom/extension definitions + executable registry
|   |-- Active/callable exposure, allow/deny, pending/hidden names
|   |-- setActiveToolsByName -> Agent tools + transcript declarations
|   `-- Built-ins [tools/index.ts]
|       |-- Default: read, bash, edit, write
|       |-- Additional: grep, find, ls, powershell
|       `-- -> adapters, file-mutation queue, truncation/renderers
|-- NestedToolCallRunner (lazy session-owned instance)
|   |-- ctx.executeTool -> callable registry -> runToolCall hooks
|   `-- Nested calls + usage -> parent tool-result message
|-- executeBash / recordBashResult (separate shell entry point)
|   |-- -> executeBashWithOperations; deltas -> subscribers
|   `-- Deferred results preserve tool-result order -> history
`-- Runtime rebuilding [session._buildRuntime / reload]
    |-- -> ResourceLoader's loaded extensions and registration state
    |-- Construct Runner + ModelRegistry; bind session/host actions
    |-- -> settings for tool construction; rebuild registry/loadout
    `-- Built-in extension factories supplied by application
        |-- llama.cpp, codemode, tool-search, MCP
        `-- Last three replaceable by matching registrations

AgentSession: canonical history and context maintenance
|
|-- SessionManager [session-manager.ts]
|   |-- Header + append-only entry tree: JSONL or memory
|   |-- Parent links, current leaf, entry indexes and labels
|   |-- Messages, selections, summaries, context edits, custom/usage
|   |-- append* -> child at leaf; branch -> moves leaf, keeps siblings
|   `-- buildSessionProjection / buildSessionContext
|       |-- Selected path + latest compaction + context edits
|       `-- Effective messages/model/thinking -> Agent live state
|-- Compaction (AgentSession-owned coordination)
|   |-- Thresholds: projection + model limits + settings
|   |-- -> compaction helpers; extension may cancel/supply summary
|   |-- Otherwise -> model-backed summary request
|   `-- appendCompaction -> refreshed projection -> Agent
|-- Tree navigation (AgentSession.navigateTree)
|   |-- -> optional generateBranchSummary
|   `-- -> manager branch operations -> restored Agent context
|-- Retry / overflow recovery (AgentSession-owned coordination)
|   |-- Budget/backoff + abortable wait
|   |-- Recovery omissions append null context edits
|   |   `-- Raw failed attempt/results remain; projection omits them
|   `-- transient -> Agent.continue(); overflow -> compaction
`-- Inspection/export (AgentSession APIs + helper modules)
    `-- Stored entries + projection + renderers -> stats/JSONL/HTML

Agent: session-held turn engine [agent.ts]
|  Held state below; execution paths use "->" for free-function calls
|
|-- MutableAgentState
|   |-- Messages (live transcript); model + thinkingLevel
|   |-- Executable tools; system prompt derived from messages
|   `-- isStreaming, streamingMessage, pendingToolCalls, errorMessage
|-- PendingMessageQueue instances
|   |-- steeringQueue: messages + one-at-a-time/all mode
|   `-- followUpQueue: messages + one-at-a-time/all mode
|-- ActiveRun (while running)
|   |-- Promise + resolver
|   `-- AbortController (Agent.abort() signals it)
|-- Listener set (awaited in subscription order)
|-- processEvents() (Agent method)
|   `-- Reduce live state -> listeners -> AgentSession event bridge
|-- Injected callbacks and execution settings
|   |-- prepareRequest / prepareNextTurn / finishTurn -> session hooks
|   |-- beforeToolCall / afterToolCall -> session tool hooks
|   `-- transformContext / convertToLlm / streamFunction supplied by SDK
`-- prompt / continue (methods and execution path)
    |-- Snapshot messages/tools; build config with queue-draining callbacks
    `-- -> runAgentLoop / runAgentLoopContinue [agent-loop.ts; free functions]
        |-- Per-invocation context, config, newMessages, lastCompletedTurn
        |-- Outer follow-ups; inner turns/tools/steering
        |   |-- -> session request/next-turn/finish-turn callbacks
        |   `-- Explicit boundary continuation can request another turn
        |-- -> streamAssistantResponse()
        |   |-- -> transformContext -> convertToLlm -> normalizeContext
        |   |-- -> injected SDK stream wrapper -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple
        |   |   `-- Session-id request -> CacheWarmer.start(request, prefix guard)
        |   `-- Stream deltas/final message -> Agent.processEvents()
        `-- -> executeToolCalls(): sequential or parallel
            |-- Resolve implementations from context.tools supplied by session
            |-- -> before hook -> tool.execute -> after hook -> result events
            `-- stopReason=length: fail every tool call without executing it

CacheWarmer: optional session-held collaborator [cache-warmer.ts]
|  SDK constructs it; AgentSession holds lifecycle/status access
|
|-- Held dependency references (not owned services)
|   |-- models -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple
|   |-- sessionManager -> getBranch / appendUsage
|   |-- getMode -> SettingsManager.getCacheWarmingMode
|   `-- decide -> ExtensionRunner.cache_warming_decision
|-- ActiveRun (at most one)
|   |-- Request model/context/options + isCurrent prefix predicate
|   |-- startedAt, TTL/delay, refresh deadline, nextWarmAt
|   |-- phase: streaming / idle; extensionOverride
|   `-- AbortController + optional refresh timer
|-- Inactive status + onWarmed callback
|   `-- -> AgentSession entry_appended subscribers
`-- Lifecycle methods
    |-- start(request, isCurrent): replace run; mode/replay/TTL checks
    |   `-- schedule timer before expiry; fixed safety windows
    |-- onAgentSettled(): streaming-only mode stops; otherwise idle
    |-- refresh(run)
    |   |-- Validate prefix/mode/deadline; evaluate cache economics
    |   |   `-- -> getBranch(): latest real request's prompt-token usage
    |   |-- -> decide hook; may stop or override warming
    |   |-- -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple: replay with one-token cap
    |   |-- Success -> SessionManager.appendUsage("cache_warm")
    |   |   `-- -> onWarmed(entry)
    |   `-- Best-effort failures; reschedule only while run is current
    |-- onModeChanged(): reconcile active run with mode
    `-- cancel(): clear timer + abort request
